free_tier.stated: 5,255 datasets across 181 organisations. Files are hosted on-portal, not linked out: resources resolve to /dataset/<uuid>/resource/<uuid>/download/<name>.xls. No per-user quota is published.

egress.terms: unmetered public GET on the download path, no token, no egress metering.

interface_detail: CKAN 2.x action API, fully live (package_search returns 200).
tooling: curl + CKAN API key. Session-based upload via /dataset/new.
chaining: none meaningful — the write path is not reachable without an institutional organisation.
limits_note: write-gated at the organisation level. `/user/register` is a plain open form (username, full name, email, password) with NO invitation code, but `POST /api/3/action/organization_create` unauthenticated returns `Acces interzis: Action organization_create is not authorized`. Publishing is per the national Law 179/2022 open-data regime, i.e. public bodies.
reliability_note: state-run, stable, but the account you can create is a consumer account: it grants no organisation, and a dataset with no owner_org is not creatable by a non-sysadmin.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, count 5255; resource URLs are https://data.gov.ro/dataset/.../download/... i.e. self-hosted bytes
HTTP 200, plain form: Username / Nume complet / E-mail / Parolă / Confirmare, no invite field
